# v29 report (generated by report_v29.py and report_v29_hw.py)

**Time rule** (`runtime_estimate.md`, `time_rule.md`): the timing runs estimated Parts B to G at 54.0 h against the limit of 48 h. Dropped at first, in the pre-registered order: Part F2 (`EB_best16`, `EB_best256`: tuning and evaluation); Part G (traces that load the network). On 25 November the user lifted the limit ("Its ok to be above of 48h limit."; `DECISIONS.md`), so these parts were taken back (their runs follow); the round takes longer than 48 h. Nothing is dropped: every part of the prompt is run.

# v29 Part B: scenarios never used (generated by report_v29.py)

Runs: B1 5130 of 5,130 (seeds 181-190), B2 540 of 540 (`LB_b0` on 2x2, seeds 121-130); missing 0; dead-end events 0.
pipe_all 2; the three scenarios `tornado`, `neighbour` and `randperm` (fault-free), which no earlier round ran and which the tuning of round 24 never saw.
Loads: the nine points of DeFT-P's ladders (`load_points_v29.md`). **THR** = the largest accepted throughput over the nine loads; **LAT** and **P99** at
1.0 x Lsat of DeFT-P. Effects in per cent (THR positive = higher, LAT and P99 negative = lower) with the 95 % interval over the ten seeds. **The best of a set
of references** is taken per size, scenario and metric by the mean over the seeds. Only the primary table is adjusted (Holm); every other interval is
unadjusted and descriptive.

## D.2 The set-up of the DeFT paper

2x2 (4 chiplets of 4x4 routers, 4 VLs per chiplet), 8-flit packets, 4-flit buffers, two VCs, DeFT's table with rho = 0.01; uniform, localized (40 % of a source's
traffic stays in its chiplet) and hotspot traffic (three routers receive 10 % each). Twelve rates per pattern and pipe depth, k / 10 x Lsat of DeFT_P for k = 1 ... 12
(Lsat of the ladder at that pipe depth). Seeds 191-195. Runs: 1800 of 1,800; dead-end events 0. Mean latency in cycles with the half-width of the 95 % interval over the
seeds. *DeFT_P against the better of the two others*: the effect in mean latency (negative = DeFT_P is faster), the better row chosen at each rate by the mean over the
seeds.

# v29 Part E1: the main row without the lookahead term (generated by report_v29.py)

`LB_noLA` = the main row with `heur_lookahead 0`: the cost of an output is 2 x the fill of the buffer behind it + the hops left (+ `lut_bias`); lookahead routing,
the fallback and the busy state stay. New runs: 1620 of 1,620 (seeds 121-130, the six fault-free scenarios, the ladders of round 25); missing 0; dead-end events 0.
The main row, DeFT_P and the references are the runs of round 25. Descriptive; effects in per cent with the unadjusted 95 % interval over the ten seeds;
2x2 / 3x3 / 4x4. The hardware of the row is in `summary_E_hw.md`.

interposer routers of the two variants of E2.

## E4.2 The bench carries that load (`hw/tb/tb_act18.v`, `tb_act25.v`)

Random 8-flit packets at these rates per port, with the measured share of heads that end at the router or take its vertical link, credits after the measured
stay; calibrated on the RTL until every rate is within 3 % of the simulator's (or the closest of ten tries). The netlist is then simulated with the same
stimulus (2,000 + 10,000 cycles; the VCD holds the 10,000) and must print the same result line as the RTL.
